settings.heading: Shipping charges
settings.content:
• Free shipping on orders above ₹2,999
  • Flat ₹99 on orders below ₹2,999

settings.heading: Delivery times
settings.content: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 working days and delivered in 3–7 working days. Remote pin codes may take a little longer.

settings.heading: Tracking
settings.content: You'll receive a tracking link by email and SMS once your order ships.

settings.heading: Returns policy
settings.content: Items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unused, unwashed and with original tags. Sale items and gift cards are not returnable unless faulty.

settings.heading: How to return
settings.content: Email us your order number and the items you'd like to return. We'll arrange a reverse pickup from your address.

settings.heading: Refunds
settings.content: Once your return passes quality check, we refund your original payment method via Razorpay within 5–7 working days.

settings.heading: Damaged or wrong item
settings.content: Email us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and we'll send a replacement or full refund at no cost to you.
